parent.entailment: Bullets for list-installed, list-dependents, show content, version, zn switching, orphans and help alias their child owners. The no-change frame, search, information, show lookup, -python, info and zn listing are the parent's own obligations, graded directly. No parent obligation is credited by composition.

obligations.text: Inspection commands show information without changing installed modules or other stores.
obligations.cases: any inspection command vs a mutating command
obligations.observation: database, files and configuration before vs after
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: inspection_state is the identity by definition, so the frame is assumed rather than derived from any command body; no inspection command (show, list-installed, search, orphans) is modeled writing nothing while a neighbour writes. orphans and list-dependents -r touch caches/temp globals that are not represented.

obligations.text: search filters modules to this platform: a deployed artifact without the current platform is hidden unless all are shown.
obligations.cases: deployed artifact with vs without the current platform
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70 (iter8 catalog.rs not linked from this block); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G7): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G7-m41, G7-m42)

obligations.text: search lists modules in all (enabled) registries, and -versions shows every version.
obligations.cases: two registries; with vs without -versions
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: grouped is exercised only with all_versions=true (no neighbour where -versions is off and only the latest shows), and repo_visited decides one registry at a time with no aggregation across registries into the printed list (Main.cls::Search / Repo/Manager.cls::SearchRepositoriesForModule). As built -versions also lifts the platform filter (Utils/Module.cls:938, review-71 A3), which the block does not say.

obligations.gap: No model of ListInstalled -python (ListInstPythonLibrariesTest only); contrast with and without the flag.

obligations.text: show shows one installed module's details, resources, dependencies and dependents.
Name and alias lookup use the module datatype's case-insensitive normalization, preserving the selected record and version.

obligations.gap: Both models take normalized keys (ext_key "upper-cased") or found-flags as inputs; no model applies the datatype normalization, so "MyAlias" vs "myalias" selecting the same record is not distinguished from a case-sensitive lookup.

obligations.text: orphans lists items in the code database that belong to no module.
help shows help for the shell or one command.
help lists every command with its aliases and summary.
obligations.cases: help with no argument
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: listed returns the constant COMMANDS() for any listing view; the 39-entry count is a fixture premise checked natively, and aliases/summaries per command are not modeled. A listing that omits a command or its aliases satisfies the rule.

obligations.text: help <command> or one of its aliases shows that command's detailed help.

obligations.gap: Rule 4a (iteration-72): command and alias resolution (tCommandStruct lookup, then the alias subscript 1, CLI.cls:26-31) is taken as input: Name::Alias(c) already carries the resolved command, so a resolver that maps an alias to the wrong command or misses it is unrepresented; the per-kind view is an outcome table

obligations.gap: Rule 4a (iteration-72): membership in STANDARDPHASES (CLI.cls:39) is not modelled; phase_shortcut is a constant naming only compile, so the claim for every other phase command (reload, validate, activate, test, package, verify, ...) has no counterpart and the model would say they do not show module-action flags
